panels.title: Peticiones
panels.description: Total de peticiones en el rango elegido.

targets.expr: sum((sum by (app) (count_over_time({contenedor="traefik"} |= `RequestPath` | json | __error__="" | entryPointName="web" | label_format ip=ClientHost,ruta=RequestPath,estado=DownstreamStatus,metodo=RequestMethod,ua=request_User_Agent,bytes=DownstreamContentSize,duracion=Duration,router=RouterName | label_format interno=`{{ if or (hasPrefix "Blackbox" .ua) (hasPrefix "10." .ip) (hasPrefix "127." .ip) (eq .ip "::1") (eq .ip "-") (eq .ip "") }}si{{ else }}no{{ end }}` | label_format app=`krivot` | app=~"$app" | interno=~"$origen" [$__range]))) or (sum by (app) (count_over_time({contenedor="minga-frontend"} | pattern `<ip> - [<_>] "<metodo> <ruta> <_>" <estado> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <_>` | ruta!="" | label_format interno=`{{ if or (hasPrefix "Blackbox" .ua) (hasPrefix "10." .ip) (hasPrefix "127." .ip) (eq .ip "::1") (eq .ip "-") (eq .ip "") }}si{{ else }}no{{ end }}` | label_format app=`minga` | app=~"$app" | interno=~"$origen" [$__range]))) or (sum by (app) (count_over_time({contenedor="sotenet-traefik"} |= `RequestPath` | json | __error__="" | entryPointName="web" | label_format ip=request_Cf_Connecting_Ip,ruta=RequestPath,estado=DownstreamStatus,metodo=RequestMethod,ua=request_User_Agent,bytes=DownstreamContentSize,duracion=Duration,router=RouterName | label_format interno=`{{ if or (hasPrefix "Blackbox" .ua) (hasPrefix "10." .ip) (hasPrefix "127." .ip) (eq .ip "::1") (eq .ip "-") (eq .ip "") }}si{{ else }}no{{ end }}` | label_format app=`sotenet` | app=~"$app" | interno=~"$origen" [$__range]))))

panels.title: Top 10 IP
panels.description: IP con más peticiones en el rango.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (ip, app) ((sum by (app, ip) (count_over_time({contenedor="traefik"} |= `RequestPath` | json | __error__="" | entryPointName="web" | label_format ip=ClientHost,ruta=RequestPath,estado=DownstreamStatus,metodo=RequestMethod,ua=request_User_Agent,bytes=DownstreamContentSize,duracion=Duration,router=RouterName | label_format interno=`{{ if or (hasPrefix "Blackbox" .ua) (hasPrefix "10." .ip) (hasPrefix "127." .ip) (eq .ip "::1") (eq .ip "-") (eq .ip "") }}si{{ else }}no{{ end }}` | label_format app=`krivot` | app=~"$app" | interno=~"$origen" [$__range]))) or (sum by (app, ip) (count_over_time({contenedor="minga-frontend"} | pattern `<ip> - [<_>] "<metodo> <ruta> <_>" <estado> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <_>` | ruta!="" | label_format interno=`{{ if or (hasPrefix "Blackbox" .ua) (hasPrefix "10." .ip) (hasPrefix "127." .ip) (eq .ip "::1") (eq .ip "-") (eq .ip "") }}si{{ else }}no{{ end }}` | label_format app=`minga` | app=~"$app" | interno=~"$origen" [$__range]))) or (sum by (app, ip) (count_over_time({contenedor="sotenet-traefik"} |= `RequestPath` | json | __error__="" | entryPointName="web" | label_format ip=request_Cf_Connecting_Ip,ruta=RequestPath,estado=DownstreamStatus,metodo=RequestMethod,ua=request_User_Agent,bytes=DownstreamContentSize,duracion=Duration,router=RouterName | label_format interno=`{{ if or (hasPrefix "Blackbox" .ua) (hasPrefix "10." .ip) (hasPrefix "127." .ip) (eq .ip "::1") (eq .ip "-") (eq .ip "") }}si{{ else }}no{{ end }}` | label_format app=`sotenet` | app=~"$app" | interno=~"$origen" [$__range])))))

panels.title: Peticiones por el túnel
panels.description: Todo lo que entra por cloudflared, sin distinguir app ni excluir sondas.

targets.expr: sum(rate(cloudflared_tunnel_total_requests[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Respuestas por código (túnel)
panels.description: Códigos HTTP devueltos a través de cloudflared.

targets.expr: sum by (status_code) (rate(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Peticiones
panels.description: Últimas peticiones: app, IP, estado, método, ruta y User-Agent.

targets.expr: {contenedor="traefik"} |= `RequestPath` | json | __error__="" | entryPointName="web" | label_format ip=ClientHost,ruta=RequestPath,estado=DownstreamStatus,metodo=RequestMethod,ua=request_User_Agent,bytes=DownstreamContentSize,duracion=Duration,router=RouterName | label_format interno=`{{ if or (hasPrefix "Blackbox" .ua) (hasPrefix "10." .ip) (hasPrefix "127." .ip) (eq .ip "::1") (eq .ip "-") (eq .ip "") }}si{{ else }}no{{ end }}` | label_format app=`krivot` | app=~"$app" | interno=~"$origen" | line_format `{{.app | printf "%-9s"}} {{.ip | printf "%-39s"}} {{.estado}} {{.metodo | printf "%-6s"}} {{.ruta}}  [{{.ua}}]`
